tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search in-stock products JENNi can deliver to a 5-digit US ZIP: local delivery first, then ship-to-home. Every product returned can be ordered; price is per unit, before the delivery or shipping fee. A product with variants and no price is a size or colour family: buy one of its variants. Sized good

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Details for one product_id: description, images, sizes and colours, and its price and delivery at the ZIP.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Returns a hosted checkout_url for an exact product and selected fulfillment mode using the delivery address. JENNi selects the source internally. The buyer reviews delivery, tax and the total, enters payment details, and places the order on the hosted page. This read-only tool creates no order, rese

tools.name: get_buying_options
tools.description: Price, delivery promise and total before tax for one product_id, ZIP, quantity and mode (local_delivery or ship_to_home). Call it when the shopper picks a product, before quoting a total.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read where a JENNi order stands: status, delivery ETA when known, courier tracking and whether the card was charged. Requires the private order_token from the shopper’s JENNi order page (starts jos1_). Read-only; it shows no personal details.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start an order JENNi will deliver, without leaving the chat. Give the exact product_id, the delivery address and the shopper's contact details. Returns the delivery options and the order total. Nothing is charged until complete_checkout. Delivered by JENNi.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Choose local_delivery or ship_to_home, or change the quantity, address or contact details of an order started with create_checkout. Call with only checkout_id to re-read it. Returns the order total once a delivery option is chosen.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Place the order. Only after the shopper has approved the total from update_checkout. Pays with the shopper's Stripe shared payment token (spt_...), issued for at least the order total. Never send card numbers. Delivered by JENNi.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_checkout · Private data: get_order_status, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: complete_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_checkout · Private data: get_order_status, create_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout · Public sink: complete_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
